page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7a.16xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server powered by an AMD EPYC 7T83 processor. It features 64 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 32 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. The system is equipped with 512.0 GB of RAM, providing a memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It operates on a KVM hypervisor and does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware. Network connectivity is supported by a 16 Gbps baseline bandwidth.

Benchmark results indicate strong performance in multi-core processing and memory subsystem efficiency. The server achieves top-tier results in stress-ng multi-core CPU tests and PassMark CPU evaluations, particularly in extended instructions and encryption workloads. Memory performance is highlighted by strong read-only bandwidth for small cached blocks and a high PassMark memory score, though large-block read and write operations fall into the average range. Single-threaded tasks, such as gzip compression and bzip3 decompression, show average performance, while multi-threaded bzip3 decompression and ray tracing benchmarks perform in the top 25%.

Given its high memory density of 8.0 GB per core and dedicated CPU allocation, the ecs.r7a.16xlarge offers qualitative resource density suitable for memory-intensive workloads without the overhead of local storage maintenance. The absence of bundled local storage means storage requirements must be met via network-attached options, which is a key architectural tradeoff. This instance is well-suited for large-scale databases, in-memory caching layers, enterprise applications, and memory-bound data processing tasks.
